payload.title: INV-SET-TOPLEVEL: inventory and remap Operator Settings unexpected top-level debt
currentProgress: Settings IMP-SET-01/02, LWR-SET, HTTP/CLI/MCP-SET adapters, CUT-SET-PROV (#1562), and BOOT-SET (#1560) are Factory-terminal.

Live pkg/services/operator_settings still has unexpected top-level dirs beside wire/, internal/, and transports/: identityinventory/, servicewire/, testlink/, testproviders/ (plus testdata/ if INV treats it as non-canonical public debt).

ownership-inventory and package-target-manifest still mark operator_settings/{identityinventory,servicewire,testlink,testproviders} as disposition retain→operator_settings; retain on unexpected siblings is debt that must become move/delete with explicit destinations.

Operator Settings root also hosts an excess .go contract/helper cluster (document_*, identity*, input_index*, inventory*, operator_config*, resolution_*, providers_root_construct.go, etc.) beyond a thin root contract.
Private subservices already exist under operator_settings/internal/services/{document,resolution}; inventory must remap public siblings into those or operator_settings/internal.
payload.requestedOutcome: Inventory every live top-level child under pkg/services/operator_settings/ and every root-level contract surface that is not the committed thin Operator Settings root contract. Remap unexpected directories (identityinventory/, servicewire/, testlink/, testproviders/, and any other INV discovers excluding wire/, internal/, transports/, and legitimate testdata if retained as test-only) and excess contract roots in package-target-manifest and ownership-inventory to disposition move or delete with explicit destinations under operator_settings/internal or operator_settings/internal/services/{document,resolution} (or INV-recorded equivalents). Regenerate package-target + ownership inventories. Prove with generator/unit tests that retain→operator_settings is rejected for these unexpected public siblings. Do not fold or delete packages in this packet. Do not invent Settings protocol adapters or reopen Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Do not reopen CUT-SET-PROV/BOOT-SET consumer edges beyond inventory remaps. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
